{"actor_id":"EO:13304","char_end":3886,"char_start":3762,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"agency_variable","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3320,"char_start":2832,"text":"Pursuant to section 202 of the NEA (50 U.S.C. 1622), termination \nof the national emergencies declared in Executive Order 12808 of May \n30, 1992, and Executive Order 13088 of June 9, 1998, shall not affect any \naction taken or proceeding pending not finally concluded or determined \nas of the effective date of this order, or any action or proceeding based \non any act committed prior to such date, or any rights or duties that \nmatured or penalties that were incurred prior to such date."},{"char_end":3752,"char_start":3321,"text":"Pursuant to \nsection 207 of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1706), I hereby determine that the continu-\nation of prohibitions with regard to transactions involving any property \nblocked pursuant to Executive Orders 12808 or 13088 that continues to \nbe blocked as of the effective date of this order is necessary on account \nof claims involving successor states to the former Socialist Federal Republic \nof Yugoslavia or other potential claimants."},{"char_end":6722,"char_start":3994,"text":"(a) Except to the extent provided in section 203(b)(1), (3), and \n(4) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(1), (3), and (4)), and the Trade Sanctions \nReform and Export Enhancement Act of 2000 (Title IX, Public Law 106–\nVerDate Jan<31>2003 15:49 May 28, 2003 Jkt 200001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\29MYE0.SGM 29MYE0\n=== PDF page 2 of 8 ===\n32316 Federal Register / Vol. 68, No. 103 / Thursday, May 29, 2003 / Presidential Documents \n387), and in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may hereafter \nbe issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered \ninto or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date of this \norder, all property and interests in property of: \n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; and \n(ii) persons designated by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, because they are determined: \n(A) to be under open indictment by the International Criminal Tribunal \nfor the former Yugoslavia, unless circumstances warrant otherwise, or \n(B) to have committed, or to pose a significant risk of committing, acts \nof violence that have the purpose or effect of threatening the peace in \nor diminishing the stability or security of any area or state in the Western \nBalkans region, undermining the authority, efforts, or objectives of inter-\nnational organizations or entities present in the region, or endangering the \nsafety of persons participating in or providing support to the activities \nof those international organizations or entities, or \n(C) to have actively obstructed, or pose a significant risk of actively ob-\nstructing, the Ohrid Framework Agreement of 2001 relating to Macedonia, \nUnited Nations Security Council Resolution 1244 relating to Kosovo, or \nthe Dayton Accords or the Conclusions of the Peace Implementation Con-\nference held in London on December 8 –9, 1995, including the decisions \nor conclusions of the High Representative, the Peace Implementation Council \nor its Steering Board, relating to Bosnia and Herzegovina, or \n(D) to have materially assisted in, sponsored, or provided financial, mate-\nrial, or technological support for, or goods or services in support of, such \nacts of violence or obstructionism or any person listed in or designated \npursuant to this order, or \n(E) to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act directly \nor indirectly for or on behalf of, any person listed in or designated pursuant \nto this order, that are or hereafter come within the United States, or that \nare or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States \npersons, are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, \nor otherwise dealt in."},{"char_end":7829,"char_start":7615,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures \nto be effective in addressing the national emergency declared in this order, \nthere need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant \nto this order."},{"char_end":8275,"char_start":8179,"text":"Such a determination \nshall become effective upon publication in the Federal Register.’’\nSec. 5."},{"char_end":9580,"char_start":9503,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on May \n29, \nReform and Export Enhancement Act of 2000 (Title IX, Public Law 106–\nVerDate Jan<31>2003 15:49 May 28, 2003 Jkt 200001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\29MYE0.SGM 29MYE0\n=== PDF page 2 of 8 ===\n32316 Federal Register / Vol. 68, No. 103 / Thursday, May 29, 2003 / Presidential Documents \n387), and in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may hereafter \nbe issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered \ninto or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date of this \norder, all property and interests in property of: \n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; and \n(ii) persons designated by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, because they are determined: \n(A) to be under open indictment by the International Criminal Tribunal \nfor the former Yugoslavia, unless circumstances warrant otherwise, or \n(B) to have committed, or to pose a significant risk of committing, acts \nof violence that have the purpose or effect of threatening the peace in \nor diminishing the stability or security of any area or state in the Western \nBalkans region, undermining the authority, efforts, or objectives of inter-\nnational organizations or entities present in the region, or endangering the \nsafety of persons participating in or providing support to the activities \nof those international organizations or entities, or \n(C) to have actively obstructed, or pose a significant risk of actively ob-\nstructing, the Ohrid Framework Agreement of 2001 relating to Macedonia, \nUnited Nations Security Council Resolution 1244 relating to Kosovo, or \nthe Dayton Accords or the Conclusions of the Peace Implementation Con-\nference held in London on December 8 –9, 1995, including the decisions \nor conclusions of the High Representative, the Peace Implementation Council \nor its Steering Board, relating to Bosnia and Herzegovina, or \n(D) to have materially assisted in, sponsored, or provided financial, mate-\nrial, or technological support for, or goods or services in support of, such \nacts of violence or obstructionism or any person listed in or designated \npursuant to this order, or \n(E) to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act directly \nor indirectly for or on behalf of, any person listed in or designated pursuant \nto this order, that are or hereafter come within the United States, or that \nare or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States \npersons, are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, \nor otherwise dealt in."},{"char_end":7225,"char_start":7011,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures \nto be effective in addressing the national emergency declared in this order, \nthere need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant \nto this order."},{"char_end":7671,"char_start":7575,"text":"Such a determination \nshall become effective upon publication in the Federal Register.’’\nSec. 5."},{"char_end":8976,"char_start":8899,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on May \n29, 2003."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13219>EO:13304@9c38543636ebf61c","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted.   Text: [Tf64c2638169b4ee0972d9f8f](#tf64c2638169b4ee0972d9f8f); absolute characters 3826–3950
- **ACT:EO:13219>EO:14033**; Sddd4a78b7d80a5af0fcd66fe; {"actor_id":"EO:14033","char_end":10019,"char_start":9353,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2318,"char_start":1212,"text":"BIDEN JR., President of the United States of America, hereby \nexpand the scope of the national emergency declared in Executive Order \n13219 of June 26, 2001 (Blocking Property of Persons Who Threaten Inter-\nnational Stabilization Efforts in the Western Balkans), as amended by Execu-\ntive Order 13304 of May 28, 2003 (Termination of Emergencies With Respect \nto Yugoslavia and Modification of Executive Order 13219 of June 26, 2001), \nfinding that the situation in the territory of the former Socialist Federal \nRepublic of Yugoslavia and the Republic of Albania (the Western Balkans), \nover the past two decades, including the undermining of post-war agreements \nand institutions following the breakup of the former Socialist Federal Repub-\nlic of Yugoslavia, as well as widespread corruption within various govern-\nments and institutions in the Western Balkans, stymies progress toward \neffective and democratic governance and full integration into transatlantic \ninstitutions, and thereby constitutes an unusual and extraordinary threat \nto the national security and foreign policy of the United States."},{"char_end":10019,"char_start":9726,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 13219, as amended \nby Executive Order 13304, and as expanded by this order, there need be \nno prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant to this order."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13219>EO:14033","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 6.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":[],"scope":"whole","signing_date":"2021-06-08","target_id":"EO:13219","verb":"transfer"}

- **ACT:EO:13224>EO:13338@48d37d0fa7b438f0**; S3c01fabf28a0f4f2ac223b04; {"actor_id":"EO:13338","char_end":5711,"char_start":3151,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2026,"char_start":1361,"text":"(b) Except to the extent provided in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to the provisions of this order in \na manner consistent with the SAA, and notwithstanding any license, permit, \nor authorization granted prior to the effective date of this order, (i) the \nSecretary of Commerce shall not permit the exportation or reexportation \nto Syria of any item on the Commerce Control List (15 C.F.R. part 774); \nand (ii) with the exception of food and medicine, the Secretary of Commerce \nshall not permit the exportation or reexportation to Syria of any product \nof the United States not included in section 1(b)(i) of this order."},{"char_end":2442,"char_start":2028,"text":"(c) No other agency of the United States Government shall permit the \nexportation or reexportation to Syria of any product of the United States, \nexcept to the extent provided in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses \nthat may be issued pursuant to this order in a manner consistent with \nthe SAA, and notwithstanding any license, permit, or authorization granted \nprior to the effective date of this order."},{"char_end":5711,"char_start":3151,"text":"(a) Except to the extent provided in section 203(b)(1), (3), and \n(4) of the IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(1), (3), and (4)), and the Trade Sanctions \nReform and Export Enhancement Act of 2000 (title IX, Public Law 106– \n387) (TSRA), or regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may be issued \npursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or \nany license or permit granted prior to the effective date of this order, \nVerDate May<04>2004 18:20 May 12, 2004 Jkt 203001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\13MYE0.SGM 13MYE0\n=== PDF page 2 of 4 ===\n26752 Federal Register / Vol. 69, No. 93 / Thursday, May 13, 2004 / Presidential Documents \nall property and interests in property of the following persons, that are \nin the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that \nare or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States \npersons, including their overseas branches, are blocked and may not be \ntransferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: persons who \nare determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the \nSecretary of State, \n(i) to be or to have been directing or otherwise significantly contrib-\nuting to the Government of Syria ’s provision of safe haven to or \nother support for any person whose property or interests in prop-\nerty are blocked under United States law for terrorism-related rea-\nsons, including, but not limited to, Hamas, Hizballah, Palestinian \nIslamic Jihad, the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine, the \nPopular Front for the Liberation of Palestine-General Command, \nand any persons designated pursuant to Executive Order 13224 of \nSeptember 23, 2001; \n(ii) to be or to have been directing or otherwise significantly contrib-\nuting to the Government of Syria ’s military or security presence \nin Lebanon; \n(iii) to be or to have been directing or otherwise significantly contrib-\nuting to the Government of Syria ’s pursuit of the development and \nproduction of chemical, biological, or nuclear weapons and \nmedium- and long-range surface-to-surface missiles; \n(iv) to be or to have been directing or otherwise significantly contrib-\nuting to any steps taken by the Government of Syria to undermine \nUnited States and international efforts with respect to the stabiliza-\ntion and reconstruction of Iraq; or \n(v) to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act for \nor on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nor interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":12802,"char_start":12589,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in this order, there need be no prior notice \nof a listing or determination made pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":13215,"char_start":13139,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 eastern daylight time on May \n12, 2004."}],"exceptions_text":["Except to the extent provided in section 203(b)(1), (3), and \n(4) of the IEEPA (50 U"],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13224>EO:13338@48d37d0fa7b438f0","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.   Text: [Ta83b25d5651a34d8efc3f5ac](#ta83b25d5651a34d8efc3f5ac); absolute characters 897–969
- **ACT:EO:13224>EO:13886**; S9b787ad7da7ad09d6cf2a88a; {"actor_id":"EO:13886","char_end":2651,"char_start":2564,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":5579,"char_start":2652,"text":"(a) All property and interests in property that are in the United \nStates, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter \ncome within the possession or control of any United States person of the \nfollowing persons are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, \nwithdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: \n(i) persons listed in the Annex to this order; \n(ii) foreign persons determined by the Secretary of State, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of the Treasury, the Attorney General, and the Secretary \nof Homeland Security: \n(A) to have committed or have attempted to commit, to pose a significant \nrisk of committing, or to have participated in training to commit acts \nof terrorism that threaten the security of United States nationals or the \nnational security, foreign policy, or economy of the United States; or \n(B) to be a leader of an entity: \n(1) listed in the Annex to this order; or \n(2) whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to \na determination by the Secretary of State pursuant to this order; \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 18:42 Sep 11, 2019 Jkt 247001 PO 00000 Frm 00001 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\12SEE0.SGM 12SEE0jbell on DSK3GLQ082PROD with PRESDOC\n=== PDF page 2 of 3 ===\n48042 Federal Register / Vol. 84, No. 177 / Thursday, September 12, 2019 / Presidential Documents \n(iii) persons determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, the Secretary of Homeland Security, and \nthe Attorney General: \n(A) to be owned, controlled, or directed by, or to have acted or purported \nto act for or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order; \n(B) to own or control, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order; \n(C) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, \nor technological support for, or goods or services to or in support of, \nan act of terrorism as defined in section 3(d) of this order, or any person \nwhose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this \norder; \n(D) to have participated in training related to terrorism provided by \nany person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant \nto this order; \n(E) to be a leader or official of an entity whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to: \n(1) a determination by the Secretary of the Treasury pursuant to this \norder; or \n(2) subsection (a)(iv) of this section; or \n(F) to have attempted or conspired to engage in any of the activities \ndescribed in subsections (a)(iii)(A) through (E) of this section; \n(iv) persons whose property and interests in property were blocked pursu-\nant to Executive Order 12947, as amended, on or after January 23, 1995, \nand remained blocked immediately prior to the effective date of this \norder."},{"char_end":6152,"char_start":5581,"text":"(b) The Secretary of the Treasury is hereby authorized to prohibit the \nopening, and prohibit or impose strict conditions on the maintaining, in \nthe United States, of a correspondent account or payable-through account \nof any foreign financial institution that the Secretary of the Treasury, in \nconsultation with the Secretary of State, has determined, on or after the \neffective date of this order, has knowingly conducted or facilitated any \nsignificant transaction on behalf of any person whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":6497,"char_start":6154,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsections (a) and (b) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order.’’ \nSec. 2."},{"char_end":7717,"char_start":7634,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on September \n10, 2019."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13224>EO:13886","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; - **ACT:EO:13224>EO:13886@3d65c301c6a9d754**; S9b787ad7da7ad09d6cf2a88a; {"actor_id":"EO:13886","char_end":2651,"char_start":2564,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":5579,"char_start":2652,"text":"(a) All property and interests in property that are in the United \nStates, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter \ncome within the possession or control of any United States person of the \nfollowing persons are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, \nwithdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: \n(i) persons listed in the Annex to this order; \n(ii) foreign persons determined by the Secretary of State, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of the Treasury, the Attorney General, and the Secretary \nof Homeland Security: \n(A) to have committed or have attempted to commit, to pose a significant \nrisk of committing, or to have participated in training to commit acts \nof terrorism that threaten the security of United States nationals or the \nnational security, foreign policy, or economy of the United States; or \n(B) to be a leader of an entity: \n(1) listed in the Annex to this order; or \n(2) whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to \na determination by the Secretary of State pursuant to this order; \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 18:42 Sep 11, 2019 Jkt 247001 PO 00000 Frm 00001 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\12SEE0.SGM 12SEE0jbell on DSK3GLQ082PROD with PRESDOC\n=== PDF page 2 of 3 ===\n48042 Federal Register / Vol. 84, No. 177 / Thursday, September 12, 2019 / Presidential Documents \n(iii) persons determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, the Secretary of Homeland Security, and \nthe Attorney General: \n(A) to be owned, controlled, or directed by, or to have acted or purported \nto act for or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order; \n(B) to own or control, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order; \n(C) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, \nor technological support for, or goods or services to or in support of, \nan act of terrorism as defined in section 3(d) of this order, or any person \nwhose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this \norder; \n(D) to have participated in training related to terrorism provided by \nany person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant \nto this order; \n(E) to be a leader or official of an entity whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to: \n(1) a determination by the Secretary of the Treasury pursuant to this \norder; or \n(2) subsection (a)(iv) of this section; or \n(F) to have attempted or conspired to engage in any of the activities \ndescribed in subsections (a)(iii)(A) through (E) of this section; \n(iv) persons whose property and interests in property were blocked pursu-\nant to Executive Order 12947, as amended, on or after January 23, 1995, \nand remained blocked immediately prior to the effective date of this \norder."},{"char_end":6152,"char_start":5581,"text":"(b) The Secretary of the Treasury is hereby authorized to prohibit the \nopening, and prohibit or impose strict conditions on the maintaining, in \nthe United States, of a correspondent account or payable-through account \nof any foreign financial institution that the Secretary of the Treasury, in \nconsultation with the Secretary of State, has determined, on or after the \neffective date of this order, has knowingly conducted or facilitated any \nsignificant transaction on behalf of any person whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":6497,"char_start":6154,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsections (a) and (b) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order.’’ \nSec. 2."},{"char_end":7717,"char_start":7634,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on September \n10, 2019."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13224>EO:13886@3d65c301c6a9d754","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; - **ACT:EO:13303>EO:13315**; See0e743b61ef0f1772031ad8; {"actor_id":"EO:13315","char_end":7762,"char_start":7114,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":4129,"char_start":2935,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 203(b)(1), (3), and (4) \nof IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(1), (3), and (4)), or regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order, all property and interests in property of the \nformer Iraqi regime or its state bodies, corporations, or agencies, or of the \nfollowing persons, that are in the United States, that hereafter come within \nthe United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or \ncontrol of United States persons, are blocked and may not be transferred, \npaid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: \n(a) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; and \n(b) persons determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State,\n(i) to be senior officials of the former Iraqi regime or their immediate \nfamily members; or\n(ii) to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act for \nor on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any of the persons listed in the \nAnnex to this order or determined to be subject to this order."},{"char_end":7762,"char_start":7487,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 13303 and expanded \nin scope in this order, there need be no prior notice of a listing or determina-\ntion made pursuant to section 1 of this order."},{"char_end":9319,"char_start":8985,"text":"Nothing in this order is intended to affect the continued effectiveness \nof any rules, regulations, orders, licenses, or other forms of administrative \naction issued, taken, or continued in effect heretofore or hereafter under \n31 C.F.R. chapter V, except as expressly terminated, modified, or suspended \nby or pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":9912,"char_start":9875,"text":"This order is effective on 12:01 a.m."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13303>EO:13315","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; {"actor_id":"EO:13350","char_end":2171,"char_start":1921,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2171,"char_start":1921,"text":"I hereby amend Executive Order \n13290 of March 20, 2003, so that the authorities therein remain in effect \nbased on the national emergency I declared in Executive Order 13303 of \nMay 22, 2003, and expanded in Executive Order 13315 of August 28, 2003."},{"char_end":3145,"char_start":2712,"text":"Pursuant to section 202(a) of the NEA (50 U.S.C. 1622(a)), termi-\nnation of the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12722 shall \nnot affect any action taken or proceeding pending but not finally concluded \nor determined as of the effective date of this order, any action or proceeding \nbased on any act committed prior to such date, or any rights or duties \nthat matured or penalties that were incurred prior to such date."},{"char_end":3588,"char_start":3146,"text":"Pursuant \nto section 207(a) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1706(a)), and subject to such regulations, \norders, directives, or licenses as may be issued pursuant to this order, \nI hereby determine that the continuation of prohibitions with regard to \ntransactions involving property blocked pursuant to Executive Orders 12722 \nor 12724 that continues to be blocked as of the effective date of this order \nis necessary on account of claims involving Iraq."},{"char_end":6040,"char_start":5750,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures \nto be effective in addressing the national emergency declared in Executive \nOrder 13303, and expanded by Executive Order 13315, there need be no \nprior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant to Executive Order \n13315 or this order."},{"char_end":7625,"char_start":7547,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July \n30, chronology does not decide legal effect.","provision_text":"Recognizing the changed circumstances in \nIraq, including the Government of Iraq’s progress in resolving and managing \nthe risk associated with outstanding debts and claims arising from actions \nof the previous regime, I hereby terminate the prohibitions contained in \nsection 1 of Executive Order 13303 of May 22, 2003, as amended by Executive \nOrder 13364 of November 29, 2004, on any attachment, judgment, decree, \nlien, execution, garnishment, or other judicial process with respect to the \nDevelopment Fund for Iraq and Iraqi petroleum, petroleum products, and \ninterests therein, and the accounts, assets, investments, and other property \nowned by, belonging to, or held by, in the name of, on behalf of, or otherwise \nfor, the Central Bank of Iraq.","sections_touched":["section 1"],"signing_date":"2014-05-27","source":{"filing_date":null,"location_confidence":"high","location_verified":false,"page_or_item":"79 FR 31019, PDF pages 1-2","requires_page_check":false,"sha256":"0b2f06166fc9eea1507a64e0caf37ac8c13842e1c2b054ef0d2dffcd5583d235","signing_date":"2014-05-27","text_path":"jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13668.txt","text_sha256":"b0ae4f340d2cf91d8d2fc3be9deb5f2c77e4f6b508aada551a952c57c776ec7f","url":"https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2014-05-29/pdf/2014-12651.pdf"},"verb":"terminate"}],"generic_refs_excluded":221,"id":"CHAIN:EO:13303","notes":"Named, located change provisions only; This action is not intended otherwise to \naffect the national emergency declared in Executive Order 13303 of May \n22, 2003, as expanded in scope by Executive Order 13315 of August 28, \n2003, which shall remain in place. \n(ii) foreign persons determined by the Secretary of State, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of the Treasury, the Attorney General, and the Secretary \nof Homeland Security: \n(A) to have committed or have attempted to commit, to pose a significant \nrisk of committing, or to have participated in training to commit acts \nof terrorism that threaten the security of United States nationals or the \nnational security, foreign policy, or economy of the United States; or \n(B) to be a leader of an entity: \n(1) listed in the Annex to this order; or \n(2) whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to \na determination by the Secretary of State pursuant to this order; \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 18:42 Sep 11, 2019 Jkt 247001 PO 00000 Frm 00001 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\12SEE0.SGM 12SEE0jbell on DSK3GLQ082PROD with PRESDOC\n=== PDF page 2 of 3 ===\n48042 Federal Register / Vol. 84, No. 177 / Thursday, September 12, 2019 / Presidential Documents \n(iii) persons determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, the Secretary of Homeland Security, and \nthe Attorney General: \n(A) to be owned, controlled, or directed by, or to have acted or purported \nto act for or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order; \n(B) to own or control, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order; \n(C) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, \nor technological support for, or goods or services to or in support of, \nan act of terrorism as defined in section 3(d) of this order, or any person \nwhose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this \norder; \n(D) to have participated in training related to terrorism provided by \nany person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant \nto this order; \n(E) to be a leader or official of an entity whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to: \n(1) a determination by the Secretary of the Treasury pursuant to this \norder; {"confidence":"medium","events":[{"actor_id":"EO:13671","char_end":6361,"char_start":2055,"confidence":"medium","how_named":"direct","id":"CHAIN:EO:13413#1","notes":"Change wording lead; chronology does not decide legal effect.","provision_text":"Subsection (a) of section 1 of Executive Order 13413 is hereby \namended to read as follows: \n‘‘(a) All property and interests in property that are in the United States, \nthat hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come \nwithin the possession or control of any United States person (including \nany foreign branch) of the following persons are blocked and may not \nbe transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: \n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; and \n(ii) any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State: \n(A) to be a political or military leader of a foreign armed group operating \nin the Democratic Republic of the Congo that impedes the disarmament, \ndemobilization, voluntary repatriation, resettlement, or reintegration of \ncombatants; \n(B) to be a political or military leader of a Congolese armed group \nthat impedes the disarmament, demobilization, voluntary repatriation, re-\nsettlement, or reintegration of combatants; \n(C) to be responsible for or complicit in, or to have engaged in, directly \nor indirectly, any of the following in or in relation to the Democratic \nRepublic of the Congo: \n(1) actions or policies that threaten the peace, security, or stability \nof the Democratic Republic of the Congo; \n(2) actions or policies that undermine democratic processes or institu-\ntions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; \n(3) the targeting of women, children, or any civilians through the \ncommission of acts of violence (including killing, maiming, torture, \nor rape or other sexual violence), abduction, forced displacement, or \nVerDate Mar<15>2010 19:28 Jul 09, 2014 Jkt 232001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\10JYE0.SGM 10JYE0mstockstill on DSK4VPTVN1PROD with E0\n=== PDF page 2 of 3 ===\n39950 Federal Register / Vol. 79, No. 132 / Thursday, July 10, 2014 / Presidential Documents \nattacks on schools, hospitals, religious sites, or locations where civil-\nians are seeking refuge, or through conduct that would constitute a \nserious abuse or violation of human rights or a violation of inter-\nnational humanitarian law; \n(4) the use or recruitment of children by armed groups or armed \nforces in the context of the conflict in the Democratic Republic of \nthe Congo; \n(5) the obstruction of the delivery or distribution of, or access to, hu-\nmanitarian assistance; \n(6) attacks against United Nations missions, international security \npresences, or other peacekeeping operations; or \n(7) support to persons, including armed groups, involved in activities \nthat threaten the peace, security, or stability of the Democratic Repub-\nlic of the Congo or that undermine democratic processes or institu-\ntions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, through the illicit \ntrade in natural resources of the Democratic Republic of the Congo; \n(D) except where intended for the authorized support of humanitarian \nactivities or the authorized use by or support of peacekeeping, inter-\nnational, or government forces, to have directly or indirectly supplied, \nsold, or transferred to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or been \nthe recipient in the territory of the Democratic Republic of the Congo \nof, arms and related materiel, including military aircraft and equipment, \nor advice, training, or assistance, including financing and financial assist-\nance, related to military activities; \n(E) to be a leader of (i) an entity, including any armed group, that \nhas, or whose members have, engaged in any of the activities described \nin subsections (a)(ii)(A) through (a)(ii)(D) of this section or (ii) an entity \nwhose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this \norder; \n(F) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, \nlogistical, or technological support for, or goods or services in support \nof (i) any of the activities described in subsections (a)(ii)(A) through \n(a)(ii)(D) of this section or (ii) any person whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to this order; or \n(G) to be owned or controlled by, or to have acted or purported to \nact for or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order.’’ \nSec. 2 .","sections_touched":["section 1"],"signing_date":"2014-07-08","source":{"filing_date":null,"location_confidence":"high","location_verified":false,"page_or_item":"79 FR 39949, PDF pages 1-3","requires_page_check":false,"sha256":"ac1fbe33a97865423170cebb64494fe5b56dd57143d05589f9a88b3aff191ad0","signing_date":"2014-07-08","text_path":"jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13671.txt","text_sha256":"4c39a4d15a81e75baa0282e34ecd262a6310b12646a960572f4e5a31114f2375","url":"https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2014-07-10/pdf/2014-16360.pdf"},"verb":"amend"}],"generic_refs_excluded":221,"id":"CHAIN:EO:13413","notes":"Named, located change provisions only; {"confidence":"medium","events":[{"actor_id":"EO:13620","char_end":4805,"char_start":1834,"confidence":"medium","how_named":"direct","id":"CHAIN:EO:13536#1","notes":"Change wording lead; chronology does not decide legal effect.","provision_text":"Section 1(a) of Executive Order 13536 is hereby amended to \nread as follows: \n‘‘(a) All property and interests in property that are in the United States, \nthat hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come \nwithin the possession or control of any United States person, including \nany foreign branch, of the following persons are blocked and may not \nbe transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn or otherwise dealt in: \n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; and \n(ii) any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State: \n(A) to have engaged in acts that directly or indirectly threaten the peace, \nsecurity, or stability of Somalia, including but not limited to: \n(1) acts that threaten the Djibouti Agreement of August 18, 2008, or the \npolitical process; \n(2) acts that threaten the Transitional Federal Institutions or future Somali \ngoverning institutions, the African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM), \nor other future international peacekeeping operations related to Somalia; \nor \n(3) acts to misappropriate Somali public assets; \n(B) to have obstructed the delivery of humanitarian assistance to Somalia, \nor access to, or distribution of, humanitarian assistance in Somalia; \n(C) to have directly or indirectly supplied, sold, or transferred to Somalia, \nor to have been the recipient in the territory of Somalia of, arms or any \nrelated materiel, or any technical advice, training or assistance, including \nfinancing and financial assistance, related to military activities; \n(D) to be responsible for or complicit in, or responsible for ordering, \ncontrolling, or otherwise directing, or to have participated in, the commission \nof acts of violence targeting civilians in Somalia, including killing and \nVerDate Mar<15>2010 21:21 Jul 23, 2012 Jkt 226001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\24JYE0.SGM 24JYE0srobinson on DSK4SPTVN1PROD with MISCELLANEOUS\n=== PDF page 2 of 3 ===\n43484 Federal Register / Vol. 77, No. 142 / Tuesday, July 24, 2012 / Presidential Documents \nmaiming, sexual and gender-based violence, attacks on schools and hospitals, \ntaking hostages, and forced displacement; \n(E) to be a political or military leader recruiting or using children in \narmed conflict in Somalia; \n(F) to have engaged, directly or indirectly, in the import or export of \ncharcoal from Somalia on or after February 22, 2012; \n(G) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, \nlogistical or technical support for, or goods or services in support of, the \nactivities described in subsections (a)(ii)(A) through (F) of this section or \nany person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant \nto this order; chronology does not decide legal effect.","provision_text":"Executive Order 12829, as \namended, is hereby further amended as follows: \n(a) the second paragraph is amended by inserting ‘‘the Intelligence Reform \nand Terrorism Prevention Act of 2004,’’ after ‘‘the National Security Act \nof 1947, as amended,’’; \n(b) Sec. 101(b) is amended to read as follows: ‘‘The National Industrial \nSecurity Program shall provide for the protection of information classified \npursuant to Executive Order 13526 of December 29, 2009, or any predecessor \nor successor order, and the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended (42 \nU.S.C. 2011 et seq.).’’; \n(c) Sec. 102(b) is amended by replacing the first paragraph with: ‘‘In \nconsultation with the National Security Advisor, the Director of the Informa-\ntion Security Oversight Office, in accordance with Executive Order 13526 \nof December 29, 2009, shall be responsible for implementing and monitoring \nthe National Industrial Security Program and shall:’’; \n(d) Sec. 102(c) is amended to read as follows: ‘‘Nothing in this order \nshall be construed to supersede the authority of the Secretary of Energy \nor the Nuclear Regulatory Commission under the Atomic Energy Act of \n1954, as amended (42 U.S.C. 2011 et seq.), or the authority of the Director \nof National Intelligence (or any Intelligence Community element) under the \nIntelligence Reform and Terrorism Prevention Act of 2004, the National \nSecurity Act of 1947, as amended, or Executive Order 12333 of December \n8, 1981, as amended, or the authority of the Secretary of Homeland Security, \nas the Executive Agent for the Classified National Security Information Pro-\ngram established under Executive Order 13549 of August 18, 2010 (Classified \nNational Security Information Program for State, Local, Tribal, and Private \nSector Entities).’’; \n(e) Sec. 201(a) is amended to read as follows: ‘‘The Secretary of Defense, \nin consultation with all affected agencies and with the concurrence of the \nSecretary of Energy, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, the Director of \nNational Intelligence, and the Secretary of Homeland Security, shall issue \nand maintain a National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (Man-\nual).","sections_touched":["paragraph i"],"signing_date":"2015-02-13","source":{"filing_date":null,"location_confidence":"high","location_verified":false,"page_or_item":"80 FR 9349, PDF pages 1-5","requires_page_check":false,"sha256":"61725b64d3753ac07fa1c48e610151280f05e5a75b7426ce2838ad97eb60e9c2","signing_date":"2015-02-13","text_path":"jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13691.txt","text_sha256":"49a80728f0cf26548ec1afee6c09f0d2b3c440a14174ff089c5950b56fac2f42","url":"https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2015-02-20/pdf/2015-03714.pdf"},"verb":"amend"}],"generic_refs_excluded":221,"id":"CHAIN:EO:13549","notes":"Named, located change provisions only; ## Valla review leads and component attestations

Review lead only. Every case needs separate applicability, earlier-ending, scope, independent-command, savings and independent whole-case review.
Preparation attestations never approve legal conclusions or replace whole-case review.

verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["hereby revoke"],"text":"Executive Order 13129 of July 4, 1999, with respect to the Taliban, in \nallowing territory under its control in Afghanistan to be used as a safe \nhaven and base of operations for Usama bin Ladin and the Al-Qaida organiza-\ntion, has been significantly altered given the success of the military campaign \nin Afghanistan, and hereby revoke that order and terminate the national \nemergency declared in that order with respect to the Taliban."},{"char_end":2363,"char_start":2136,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2363,"context_char_start":2136,"line":37,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["is amended"],"text":"The Annex to Executive Order 13224 of September 23, 2001, \nis amended by adding thereto the following persons in appropriate alphabet-\nical order: \nMohammed Omar (aka, Amir al-Mumineen [Commander of the Faithful]) \nThe Taliban."},{"char_end":2813,"char_start":2644,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2813,"context_char_start":2644,"line":45,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["is hereby authorized"],"text":"The Secretary of State, in consulta-\ntion with the Secretary of the Treasury, is hereby authorized to modify \nthe definition of the term ‘‘the Taliban,’’ as appropriate."},{"char_end":3054,"char_start":2823,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":3054,"context_char_start":2823,"line":48,"pdf_page":1,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"Nothing contained in this order shall create any right or benefit, \nsubstantive or procedural, enforceable by any party against the United States, \nits agencies or instrumentalities, its officers or employees, or any other \nperson."},{"char_end":3743,"char_start":3308,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":3743,"context_char_start":3308,"line":55,"pdf_page":2,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"Pursuant to section 202 of the NEA (50 U.S.C. 1622), termination \nof the national emergency with respect to the Taliban shall not affect any \naction taken or proceeding pending not finally concluded or determined \nas of the date of this order, or any action or proceeding based on any \nact committed prior to the date of this order, or any rights or duties that \nmatured or penalties that were incurred prior to the date of this order."}]},{"affected_orders":["EO:13274"],"availability":"citation_or_pointer_only","kind":"operative_current_law","reasons":["No uniquely located attributed legal-text slice is held for this current-law pointer;
